text:
sophia.g: FYI vendor (AegisAssess) confirmed slot Mon May 5 09:00 PT for a blackbox. Need quick runbook for: ephemeral RBAC changes, KMS key-wrap proxy, log sampling & sanitized evidence export. Who picks these up?

raj.n: I can handle RBAC diffs. Plan: create pen-test-assessor role with only AssumeRole via IdP, timebound session 4h, and explicit deny to write-prod. Will post terraform diff.

emily.l: I'll own KMS and evidence path. Idea: use kms-proxy to issue a wrapping key scoped to the assessor role TTL. No customer key rotation. We'll generate pre-signed S3 manifests and a scrub script.

tyler_sre: I'll draft rollback steps and the minimal monitoring hooks (CloudWatch alarms we can mute). Also will reserve a retest slot Wed May 7 10:00 PT.

sophia.g: Good. Quick constraints: assessor must auth via SSO (SCIM) + OIDC assertion. Only if vendor cannot do SSO we will create sandboxed accounts that expire. Document exceptions.

raj.n: Terraform snippet I will use (preview):
```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "pen_assessor" {
  name = "pen-test-assessor-${var.eng_short}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json
  max_session_duration = 14400 # 4h
  tags = { pen_test = "true" }
}
# revert: delete role and revoke sessions at 13:30 PT
```
I'll annotate exact ARNs.

emily.l: KMS proxy commands we plan to run (staging dry-run first):
```bash
# issue ephemeral KMS-wrapping key scoped to role
vault write kms/proxy/wrap key_id="proxy-pt" ttl=4h principal=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pen-test-assessor
# generate presigned s3 path
aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence-bucket/assessor-1835600123/manifest.json --expires-in 14400
```
I'll add the scrub pipeline: remove PII fields via jq rules and redact IPs.

tyler_sre: For logs: we will sample traces at 5% by request id for the window and run the export to s3 with an intermediate scrub job. Export command:
```bash
aws logs create-export-task --task-name pt-sample --log-group-name /redwood/inference --from 1835596400000 --to 1835603200000 --filter-pattern "?requestId" --destination s3://pt-evidence-bucket/temp
```
Make sure we keep only the fields requested by assessor.

sophia.g: Security note: no customer plaintext data in evidence. If vendor requests raw traces we require an NDA addendum and product approval.

emily.l: I'll run a staging dry-run today 15:00 PT and post manifest + sanitized sample.

raj.n: Quick Q: rollback cadence? If pen test runs into issues and we must emergency revert, what's the timeline?

tyler_sre: Rollback plan:
- immediately revoke sessions for pen-test-assessor role (aws iam revoke-session)
- delete role after 30m window if safe
- revoke KMS proxy tokens and delete wrapping key
- restore any muted alarms
We aim for full revert within 45 minutes.

sophia.g: @oncall-bot create channel #pt-1835600123 and invite vendor when live. Keep all communications there.

oncall-bot: Reminder: incident channel #pt-1835600123 created. Use for live comms and evidence uploads.

emily.l: After we get vendor report we'll create a remediation tracker CSV with columns: id, summary, owner, priority, component, fix_eta, verification_steps, retest_slot. Will map high-severity to next-business-day triage.

sophia.g: Sounds good. Keep follow-ups as separate threads per remediation item to avoid noise. Thanks team — post staging dry-run results here.

(Short channel; followups on triage/remediation will be separate threads.)
